    theme Package

    Theme and template system

    Owns every visual decision a pagify site makes: the HTML template, the stylesheet and the progressive-enhancement scripts.

    Functions

    Default() (*Theme, error)

    Returns the theme embedded in the binary.

    theme, err := theme.Default()

    Theme

    type Theme struct {
    templates *template.Template
    assets    fs.FS
}

    AssetDir

    The output-relative directory theme assets are written to. Templates reference the same path, so the two cannot drift apart.

    const AssetDir = "assets"

    Embedded Assets

    The default theme embeds:

    • template.html — semantic document: header, nav, main, article, footer
    • styles.css — design system built on CSS custom properties
    • script.js — theme toggle, mobile drawer, code-block copy buttons
    • search.js — client-side search over the generated index
    • favicon.ico / favicon.svg

    Adding a Theme

    A theme is a template plus an asset tree. Embed it the way theme.Default does and resolve it by name in build.Build. Nothing in internal/site or internal/markdown needs to change, because neither knows a theme exists.
